summary.description: The two-axis report in GitHub Markdown: Standards, Spec, and a one-line total for each axis.

findings.description: Findings worth inline comments, anchored to the new side of the PR diff.

finding_id.description: Stable defect identity in the form axis:stable-subject:short-rule-slug, independent of the current path. Reuse an earlier matching ID for the same defect across prose, path, symbol, or line changes.

path.description: Repository-relative path exactly as it appears in the diff.

line.description: Line in the new file version that appears in a PR diff hunk.

body.description: Self-contained GitHub Markdown citing the standard, spec, or contract supporting the finding.
